idea-plugin.name: CodeMap
idea-plugin.description:
CodeMap is a powerful visualization tool for Android Studio that helps developers understand complex codebases by showing function call chains. It builds interactive graphs that illustrate "who calls whom" in your Kotlin project.

Key Features:

  • Call Chain Visualization: Trace logic from entry points (like onCreate) to the deepest levels of your code.
  • Smart Categorization: Different colors for UI, Network, Storage, Async, and System calls.
  • Interactive Branching: Choose which path of 'if/when' conditions to explore in the graph.
  • Architecture Audit: Automatically detect violations in Clean Architecture, MVVM, and SRP (Single Responsibility Principle).
  • Navigation: One-click jump from the graph node directly to the source code line.
  • K2 Compatible: Fully supports the new IntelliJ/Kotlin K2 mode.

Requirements:

To ensure the interactive visualization works correctly, CodeMap requires a JetBrains Runtime (JBR) or a JDK with JCEF (Java Chromium Embedded Framework) support (version 21 or higher). If the tool window appears empty, please switch your IDE Runtime to the bundled JBR (Shift+Shift -> 'Choose IDE Runtime').

How to use:

  1. Click "🚀 Analyze Project" to build the latest map.
  2. Select a file and function in the side panel.
  3. Explore the interactive chain and use filters to hide system logs or Android internal calls.

CodeMap is essential for architectural reviews, onboarding new developers, and debugging complex data flows.
